info.title: rsxp Live Game API
info.description: Loopback API for game state, Pokémon Essentials party data, and bounded input. Start it from the egui Game API panel, or use RSXP_API=1 for headless runs.

200.description: Actual RGSS tile layers and bitmap names for one map

parameters.description: Number of game updates to hold the key
